entities.summary: Arvid Söderblom is a Swedish professional ice hockey player who is a goaltender for the Chicago Blackhawks of the National Hockey League (NHL). He previously played in the Swedish Hockey League (SHL) for Frölunda HC and Skellefteå AIK.
